verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://gecko.security/openapi.json, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The documented v1 API covers scans, repositories, vulnerabilities, triage, schedules and webhooks, which is the surface that spec would describe. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly pointing users to the spec download, and confirmation that the spec covers the full v1 API.
